scientific_integrity: Explicit proof and reproducible standard-library checker included. Finite tests support, but cannot replace, the proof of universal assertions. Literature searches do not establish global uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Two-term unweighted Müntz projectors on [0,1] only; not a multi-term, weighted, or sampled least-squares theorem. The affine endpoint value is classical; historical priority of the complete exponent-dependent comparison is not independently certified. A 2005 monograph chapter on projection types was not inspected in full.
title: Sharp endpoint stability and an affine optimum in the first Müntz projection
